canonicalization: sha256 of json.dumps(contract, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":")) evaluated with unlock_gate.i1_contract_sha256 set to the empty string; verification replaces that field with "" and recomputes

corpus.historical_prefix_policy: descriptive only; separate stratum; never pooled with ordinary pilot

decision_rubric.binding: decision tree evaluated top-down yields exactly one of A/B/C; pilot is not confirmatory
decision_rubric.cell_definition: each distinct raw value of a primary variable is one cell; outcome-driven binning, collapsing, or pair selection after unlock is forbidden
decision_rubric.complete_R5_fraction_definition: cases with R5 status complete divided by 32 ordinary pilot cases
decision_rubric.consistent_pair_definition: for pair (A,B): dH = median(cellA,H) - median(cellB,H) for H in {R3,R5,R10}; CONSISTENT(pair) iff all three dH are nonzero and share the same sign

decision_tree.condition: at least one CONSISTENT(pair) exists across any qualifying variable

decision_rubric.effect_size_reporting: per-cell median and MAD of R5 on common-complete intersections; Cliff's delta for every enumerated pair; no significance-threshold gate
decision_rubric.evaluated_on: primary endpoint R5 across primary explanatory variables; descriptive, non-confirmatory
decision_rubric.pair_enumeration: all unordered cell pairs of each qualifying variable, each pair evaluated on that pair's common-complete case intersection across R3/R5/R10
decision_rubric.qualifying_variable: at least two distinct value cells each with n >= 5 cases that are common-complete for R3/R5/R10
decision_rubric.taxonomy_v2_diagnostic: reported separately from the A/B/C decision: true iff every annotation-derived descriptive_only variable is constant or near-constant (non-dominant share <= 2/32) in the sealed corpus; never feeds the decision tree

eligible_observation_clock.H_k: k-th eligible observation after T, k in {1,3,5,10}
eligible_observation_clock.clock: exchange trading sessions of the mapped instrument
eligible_observation_clock.eligible_observation: a session date d with d > T, present in the instrument hfq series, with finite positive hfq close
eligible_observation_clock.right_censor_rule: if fewer than k eligible observations within 60 exchange sessions after T -> endpoint status right_censored for that k
eligible_observation_clock.skip_rule: session present for the exchange but absent/invalid for the instrument -> skipped, logged with reason; never counted as zero return
eligible_observation_clock.trading_calendar_proxy: union of session dates across the frozen baostock store universe (5,240 files pinned by the closed-world price-store manifest); materialized and hashed at I2 unlock

missing_data.censoring_denominator: censored cases stay in the corpus ledger and are excluded only from the affected endpoint summary with both counts reported
missing_data.duplicate_session_rule: duplicate session rows -> data_error for that case, quarantine before unlock-phase computation completes

secondary.MAE10: min over eligible i in 1..10 of (P_i/P0 - 1), simple return
secondary.MAE5: min over eligible i in 1..5 of (P_i/P0 - 1), simple return
secondary.MFE10: max over eligible i in 1..10 of (P_i/P0 - 1), simple return
secondary.MFE5: max over eligible i in 1..5 of (P_i/P0 - 1), simple return
secondary.first_hit_band_5_10: first eligible i in 1..10 reaching (P_i/P0-1) >= +0.05 or <= -0.05; ties by earliest session; band = up/down/none, session index recorded
secondary.return_convention: R* are natural-log gross ratios; MFE/MAE and band thresholds are simple returns; never mixed in one endpoint

descriptive_only.name: etf_state_vector
descriptive_only.reason: per-slot cells too sparse for a 32-case pilot

descriptive_only.name: stock_layer_report_period_recency
descriptive_only.reason: empty string tied to NO_PIT_VISIBLE_REPORT; redundant, descriptive

prespecified_blocking.name: era
prespecified_blocking.role: blocking/stratification only; never an interpretive variable

primary.missing_handling: none expected; any unseen value at unlock -> coverage incident, not pooled
primary.name: stock_layer_summary

explanatory_variables.selection_basis: chosen from I0/I0.1/I0.2 outcome-free cross-case distributions before any outcome read; near-zero-variation annotation fields are frozen as descriptive diagnostics

interpretation_limits: 32 cases are a pilot; no stable probabilities, thresholds, or trading rules
association is not causation; annotation variables are descriptive strata
sparse cells are reported as sparse, never as null or strong evidence

origin.P0: hfq_adjusted close of the mapped instrument on T
origin.P0_identity_cross_check: unadjusted close on T in the frozen price store must equal the packet price_panel last value on T (machine check at unlock)
origin.T_semantics: blinded anchor date carried in the sealed packet; decision clock CLOSE_AFTER_T
origin.origin_unresolved_rule: if T row missing or cross-check fails -> origin_unresolved, excluded from endpoint numerators, kept in denominator ledger

closed_world_commitment.i2_unlock_verification: re-hash every declared file and require exact equality of bytes and sha256 per entry and of the closed-world file set before any outcome value is read

selector_mapping_secret.policy: secret bytes hashed only during I1; not parsed, decoded, mapped, or semantically inspected; consulted only inside the logged I2 unlock ceremony
